performance.verdict: No paid activity live; 5 overdue milestones are the real emergency.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages were all due 2026-07-31 — 34 days overdue with no completion event recorded.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting were due 2026-08-01 — 33 days overdue; $0 spend across all 45 series days confirms neither went live.
Spend efficiency is unmeasurable: $0 spend, 0 paid leads, and 0 CPL across the entire 28-day window — no paid channel is running.
GBP 3-day signal (Aug 31–Sep 2): 0 actions vs prior 3-day avg of ~1.3 — a hard drop after a 28-day average of ~3 actions/day, suggesting profile visibility loss.
GHL shows 109 contacts and 20 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won — intake pipeline exists but is producing no consultations, independent of ads.

suggestions.text: Escalate SOW blockers to Nacer immediately: clear Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site launch this week.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are confirmed overdue by 33–34 days with $0 spend across all 45 tracked days. Nacer (Ops) must confirm Pre-Launch Stack Test passed, LSA Verification submitted, and site/landing pages live before any ad spend can begin. Success check: all three completion events logged in monday.com by 2026-09-10. No paid media suggestions are possible until these gates clear.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline: 109 contacts, 20 opps, 0 appointments — identify why no consultations are being booked.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 109 contacts and 20 opportunities created but zero appointments booked and zero cases won. This is an intake/routing failure unrelated to ads — the booking calendar, auto-reply, or assignment routing is likely misconfigured. Confirm calendar availability, booking links, and speed-to-lead routing are functional. Success check: at least 1 confirmed appointment booked in GHL by 2026-09-07.
